description: Weekly reconstruction from every official Bitmine release since Nov 30, 2025. Share counts are official at 10-Q checkpoints (checkpoints.json) and estimated between them by rolling the current model forward from the latest checkpoint. est_* / assumed_* fields are estimates; see README "Share-count reconstruction".

model.label: v3 – 10-Q ETH price, capped carry (current)
model.eth_price: per week: disclosed (10-Q quarter) / assumed (pooled 10-Q factor)
model.staking_yield: per week: Bitmine-stated 7-day yield (CESR stand-in where recorded); CESR weekly average (data/cesr.json) only for weeks with neither

quarters.derivation: Units: 3,737,140 held Nov 30, 2025 − 1,874,927 held Aug 31, 2025 − ~327 staking (=$980K staking additions ÷ ~$3,000). Cost: 'Additions from the purchase of ETH' $7,527,221K (cash paid in the cash-flow statement was $7,402,573K; the ~$125M difference was paid in December).
quarters.market_avg_source: Computed offline (no weekly releases before Nov 30, 2025 in releases.json): ETH added per weekly 8-K (Aug 31 → Nov 30, 2025 holdings: 1,866,974; 2,069,443; 2,151,676; 2,416,054; 2,650,900; 2,830,151; 3,032,188; 3,236,014; 3,313,069; 3,395,422; 3,505,723; 3,559,879; 3,629,701; 3,726,499) × that week's average daily ETH close (Yahoo Finance ETH-USD).

quarters.derivation: Units: 4,473,459 held Feb 28 − 3,737,140 held Nov 30 − ~3,780 staking (=$10,201K ÷ ~$2,700). Cost: 6-month additions $9,536,645K − Q1 $7,527,221K. Cash paid (cash-flow statement) was $2,134,422K: includes ~$125M for ETH added in November.

Units: 9-month purchases 3,518,278 (Note 4 roll-forward, exact) − Q1 1,861,886 − Q2 732,539. Cost: 9-month purchases $11,573,152K − 6-month $9,536,645K. Cash paid (cash-flow statement) was $2,150,498K; the 9-month cash paid for digital assets exceeds 9-month additions by $112.5M (not explained in the filing).

Units: FY purchases 3,973,023 − 9-month purchases 3,518,278 (Note 4 roll-forward). Cost: FY ETH purchases $12,410,908K − 9-month $11,573,152K. Cash paid for digital assets was $12,553,572K for the year vs $11,687,493K for the nine months, so Jun–Aug cash paid was $866,079K.
quarters.source: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended August 31, 2026, Note 4

eth_price.note: paid_per_eth = 10-Q cost of ETH purchased ÷ units purchased; market_avg_weighted = weekly average ETH price weighted by ETH added each week; factor = paid ÷ market.

buyback_aggregate.note: 'In 2026, Bitmine has repurchased 22.9 million common shares, at an average price of $17.48 or an aggregate amount of $399.6 million' (Oct 26, 2026 release). Used to calibrate undisclosed weekly buyback prices.

method.weekly_cash_opex_source: Net operating cash outflow Dec 1, 2025 – Aug 31, 2026 = FY2026 operating cash flow (−$305.149M, 10-K) − Sep–Nov (−$228.356M, 10-Q Nov 30, 2025) = −$76.793M over 39 weeks = $1,969,051/wk. Same rule as before (treasury-era operating cash flow), now with the Jun–Aug quarter (−$17.557M). Already net of interest income and cash service revenue. Previously $2,278,000 (Dec–May, 26 weeks). (v1 used $3,257,538 = Mar–May G&A − SBC + cost of sales ÷ 13.)
method.bmnp_weekly_dividend_source: 3,500,000 BMNP shares (June 10, 2026 offering) × $0.1847 regular weekly dividend (dividend schedule, 8-K Aug 14, 2026).
method.issue_price: average BMNR daily close over the week (range bounds use the week's highest / lowest close)
method.purchase_price: Per week: 'disclosed' = the week's average daily ETH price × that fiscal quarter's 10-Q factor (cost of ETH purchased ÷ units ÷ purchase-weighted weekly average); 'assumed' (weeks after the last filed quarter) = weekly average × the factor pooled over all filed quarters, range ± eth_price_uncertainty. See checkpoints.json → eth_cost_quarterly and backtest.json → eth_price.
method.staking_rewards: ETH staked 5 reports earlier (min over the last 6 reports) × that week's stated 7-day BMNR yield (release-quoted CESR stand-in where no Bitmine yield was stated; CESR weekly average only if neither) × days/365. The CESR weekly average (data/cesr.json) is shown as an independent check.
method.investments_source: Disclosed cash spent on non-ETH investments in the weekly releases (Beast Industries $186M wk of Jan 25 = $180M cash + $6M costs per the 10-Q, Eightco/ORBS ~$80M wk of Mar 15, Pier Two ~$6M cash wk of Mar 29) — releases.json investments_usd.
method.staking_source: Rewards accrue only on ETH that was already staked 4 weekly reports earlier (validator entry-queue lag). Fitted to the 10-Q staking revenue: model $55.6M vs reported non-cash staking revenue $52.5M for Dec 2025–May 2026 (lag 0 gave $80.0M).
method.carry_forward_source: A week whose cash fell by less than its spending (or rose) leaves a surplus that offsets the next weeks' shortfalls, for at most 3 weeks and $5M in total (oldest used first; anything older or above the cap is dropped). Noise-sized: releases round cash to the nearest $1M and the ETH price assumption alone is ±1%.
method.eth_price_uncertainty_source: Largest quarterly deviation of the 10-Q price paid from the pooled factor (Dec–Feb −0.8%, Mar–May +0.7%), rounded up to 1%.
method.use_onchain_price_source: On-chain tracker transfers (data/onchain-purchases.json) are settlement withdrawals valued at spot by the trackers; pricing tracked weeks with them made the Dec 2025–May 2026 quarterly ETH cost less accurate than the weekly average, so they are shown as a cross-check only.
method.staking_lag_basis: Lag 5 chosen because it reproduces the 10-K's ETH received from staking best: modeled 55,132 vs 53,877 actual for Sep 2025–Aug 2026 (+2.3%); lag 4 was +7.3%, lag 6 −2.7%. Chosen on the staking units, not on the share backtest.
